corpus.description: Domain-matched prompts for the uploaded Class 10 chemical reactions Hindi and Hinglish lecture.
corpus.audioUse: The long lecture may supply in-house diagnostic windows and source-timed real speech controls. Do not upload its audio to a vendor unless the speaker's permission is recorded. Cross-provider identity tests use the same consented owner reference for every provider.
corpus.promptProvenance: Authored benchmark prompts matched to the source domain. They are not quoted from the lecture.
